recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic low-angle photograph of four subjects leaning over a balcony railing in a multi-story stairwell, framed by strong diagonal architectural lines and overlaid with bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Strong diagonal perspective of the balcony railings leading from bottom-right to top-left
High-contrast relationship between the yellow display text and the dark architectural shadows
Vertical subjects staggered along the diagonal axis of the composition
Primary color interaction between yellow, red, and cyan text elements
coreInvariants: White border or header strip at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four human subjects positioned in the right half of the frame, decreasing in scale as they recede into the upper-right background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow display text in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the yellow title, follows the diagonal railing down to the subjects, and finishes on the red and blue text in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is dominated by the dark, shadowed interior of the stairwell, providing a high-contrast base for the yellow text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and greys from the architectural photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the primary display title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red and cyan for secondary and tertiary information.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation text overlays against a low-saturation, mid-value photographic background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely condensed proportions for the main title
Extended, wide proportions for the secondary red text
Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation
Flat terminals and tight letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the yellow title features a very narrow, vertical spine
The 'E' in the red text has elongated horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast (ultra-condensed vs. expanded) using similar grotesque skeletons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed verticality of the main title
Matches the wide, square-ish proportions of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph looking up a modern stairwell with multiple concrete or metal balconies. Four people in 1960s suits should be leaning over the railings, looking down at the camera. The lighting should create deep shadows on the left and bright highlights on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white horizontal bar at the top with small black sans-serif text. Place a large yellow ultra-condensed title in the upper left. Place red expanded sans-serif text in the lower right, followed by cyan blue text in the same style.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective looking sharply upward?
Are there three distinct text colors (yellow, red, cyan)?
Is the main title extremely tall and narrow?
Is the secondary text extremely wide?

adjustableVariables: Specific primary colors used for text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the faces of the subjects
Check that the diagonal lines of the architecture are straight and consistent
Verify the white header strip is present at the top edge
Confirm the color palette is limited to primary tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle architectural portrait with high-contrast, width-clashing sans-serif typography in primary colors.
